## Change

Describe the problem, behavior change, and related issues/repositories.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes in every changed repository.
- [ ] Regression tests or feature tests cover the change.
- [ ] Public core/SDK changes pass every plugin's checks.
- [ ] Relevant build, browser, and external-service tests pass.
- [ ] README/TSDoc changes match the implemented behavior.
- [ ] No secrets, local data, or build artifacts are included.

List tests not run, failures, dependencies added, and follow-ups explicitly.
